name: Uzbekistan
famous_for: Legendary Silk Road oasis cities: Registan of Samarkand, turquoise minarets of Bukhara, walled mud-brick citadel of Khiva, and Plov.
tourists: Over 6.6M international visitors; famous for Registan turquoise madrasahs, Shah-i-Zinda mausoleum avenue, and Chorsu Bazaar.
must_know: Bread (Non) is held in sacred regard; it is torn by hand with both hands and never placed upside down or cut with a knife.
fun_fact: Samarkand is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in Central Asia, flourishing as the glittering capital of the Timurid Empire.
